_about: Names for Save as, read by src-tauri/src/names.rs (via src-tauri/tests/common/save_names.rs) and by tests/ui/names.test.js. A name is a string, or a rule {"before": text, "repeat": text, "times": n, "then": text} for a long name, which is the optional before text, then the repeat text n times, then the optional then text. "refused" is keyed by the NameProblem variant a name must give. Each name is the stem; the extension is added to it. Every character outside printable ASCII is a \uXXXX escape, so an editor cannot change one unnoticed (a test checks it).
